name: Google Gemini (AI Studio & Vertex AI)
author: DJLegends
description: Adds two connection kinds for Google's Gemini models: "Google AI Studio (Gemini API)" for AI Studio API keys, and "Google Vertex AI" for Vertex express-mode API keys, OAuth access tokens, or a pasted service-account / gcloud application-default JSON. A reasoning effort turns on Gemini thinking and shows the thought summary as the reply's reasoning; safety filters can be switched off for fiction.
